meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按用户指定的时间段读取本地 screenpipe 的屏幕记录;完全依赖该服务,不可达时拒绝运行。它会聚类重复工作流程,与现有技能比对,为未覆盖的模式起草新技能或组合现有技能的配方,输出提案文件夹供用户审阅。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求分析自己的近期工作并提出新技能时触发,例如“分析我最近几小时/一天/一周的工作”、“找出尚未覆盖的流程”、“根据近期工作流起草技能”等。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作,提议要新建的技能。
say.note: Claude 会读取本地录像,生成提案文件。

say.text: 看下我最近一周的操作,哪些流程还没技能覆盖?
say.note: 它会聚类重复模式并与现有技能比对。

say.text: 根据我最近的工作流,写几条组合现有技能的配方。
say.note: 会输出可审查的 SKILL.md 草稿。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads local screenpipe recordings in a specified time range, clusters repeating workflows, matches existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for gaps, outputting proposals for review.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit user request to analyze recent work and propose skills, e.g. 'analyze my last day/week', 'find uncovered workflows', or 'draft a skill from my recent workflow'.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: Claude reads local screenpipe data and generates proposals.

say_en.text: Check my last week's workflows for uncovered gaps.
say_en.note: It clusters patterns and matches them against existing skills.

say_en.text: Based on my recent workflow, draft composition recipes.
say_en.note: Emits thin SKILL.md files that chain existing skills.
